description: Investigate one IP: inbound/outbound rate, protocol/app mix, and a compact Flow summary (Top N, default 8).

panels.description: Bits per second for this IP. Outbound = this IP is the flow source; Inbound = this IP is the destination. Use Role to show only one side. Table totals stay in bytes.

targets.query:
SELECT
    $timeSeries AS t,
    multiIf(
        ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote} AND ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}, 'Self',
        ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}, 'Outbound',
        'Inbound'
    ) AS direction,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) * 8 / $interval AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND ${ip:singlequote} != ''
  AND (
        (${role:singlequote} = 'any' AND (
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}
         OR ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}
        ))
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'src' AND ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'dst' AND ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
  )
GROUP BY t, direction
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Traffic rate (Inbound / Outbound)

panels.description: Main conversation table for this IP. Outbound = this IP → peer; Inbound = peer → this IP. Application inferred from well-known ports (else port-NNNN). Rows controlled by Top N (default 8).

targets.query:
SELECT
    direction,
    peer,
    application,
    if(service_port = 0, NULL, service_port) AS port,
    protocol,
    sum(traffic) AS traffic,
    sum(packets) AS packets,
    sum(flows) AS flows
FROM
(
    SELECT
        multiIf(
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote} AND ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}, 'Self',
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}, 'Outbound',
            'Inbound'
        ) AS direction,
        if(ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}, ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), ipToStr(src_addr, etype)) AS peer,
        multiIf(
      nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '',
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
      nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '',
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
      dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
      src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(src_port)),
      concat('port-', toString(if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port)))
    ) AS application,
        multiIf(
      nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '', dst_port,
      nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '', src_port,
      dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, dst_port,
      src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, src_port,
      if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port)
    ) AS service_port,
        ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
        bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate) AS traffic,
        packets * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate) AS packets,
        1 AS flows
    FROM $table
    WHERE $timeFilter
      AND ${ip:singlequote} != ''
  AND (
        (${role:singlequote} = 'any' AND (ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote} OR ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}))
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'src' AND ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'dst' AND ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
  )
)
GROUP BY direction, peer, application, port, protocol
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero(${topn:singlequote})

panels.title: Flow summary

panels.description: Layer-4 protocol mix for this IP (TCP / UDP / ICMP / …).

targets.query:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    proto = 6, 'TCP',
    proto = 17, 'UDP',
    proto = 1, 'ICMP',
    proto = 58, 'ICMPv6',
    proto = 47, 'GRE',
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))
  ) AS protocol,
  sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND ${ip:singlequote} != ''
  AND (
        (${role:singlequote} = 'any' AND (
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}
         OR ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}
        ))
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'src' AND ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'dst' AND ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
  )
GROUP BY protocol
ORDER BY traffic DESC

panels.description: Application mix from well-known ports. Unknown ports are labeled port-NNNN.

targets.query:
SELECT
  multiIf(
      nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '',
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
      nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '',
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
      dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
      src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(src_port)),
      concat('port-', toString(if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port)))
    ) AS application,
  sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND ${ip:singlequote} != ''
  AND (
        (${role:singlequote} = 'any' AND (
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}
         OR ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote}
        ))
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'src' AND ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
     OR (${role:singlequote} = 'dst' AND ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = ${ip:singlequote})
  )
GROUP BY application
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT 12
